IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
 CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION NO. 2581 OF 2025 
Farooq Chand Mohammad Quresh …Applicant
V/s.
The State of Maharashtra ...Respondent.
 …………..
Mr. T ohid Shaikh for the Applicant. 
Mr. V.N. Sagare, APP for the Respondent/State.
PI  Ajitsingh Rajput  and  PSI Bajrang  Desai,  Samta  Nagar  Police
Station present.  
…………..
CORAM : N.R. BORKAR, J.
DATE      : 30.09.2025.  
P .C. :
1. This is an application for anticipatory bail.
2. The applicant is apprehending his arrest in Crime N o. 981 of
2024 registered at Samta Nagar Police Station for the offen ces
punishable under Sections 115(2), 118(2), 126(2), 309( 4), 324(2)
and 61(2) read with Section 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya S anhita,
2023.
3. According  to  the  first  informant,  on  the  date  of  inci dent,
which took place on 16 th December 2024, three unknown persons
assaulted  him  by  iron rod  due  to  which he  sustained  frac ture
injury  to  his  right  leg.  According  to  the  prosecution,  th e  first
informant was assaulted due to certain business related issu es
and the present applicant was one of the assailant.
4. I have heard the learned counsel appearing for the app licant
and the learned APP for the respondent / State.
Dinesh S. Sherla 1/2
DINESH

SHERLA

5. The anticipatory bail is sought on the ground of pa rity. In
support of said ground, the learned counsel for the appl icant has
produced on record copy of order passed by this Court da ted 10 th
September 2025 in Anticipatory Bail Application No. 2466 of 2025.
By  the  said  order,  this  Court  has  released  the  co-accused
Jeetendra L. Patil on anticipatory bail.
6. I have perused the charge-sheet. The role attributed to the
present applicant and co-accused Jeetendra Patil  appears to  be
identical.  Considering the said fact, I am inclined to r elease the
applicant on anticipatory bail. In the result the follo wing order is
passed.
ORDER
A) The Application is allowed.
B) In the event of arrest of the applicant in C.R. No. 9 81 of
2024  registered  at  Samta  Nagar  Police  Station  for  the
offences punishable under Sections 115(2), 118(2), 126(2) ,
309(4),  324(2)  and  61(2)  read  with  Section  3(5)  of  the
Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, he be released on bail o n
executing P .R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety
or two sureties in the like amount.
C) The applicant shall attend the concerned police station
from 6th October 2025 to 8 th October 2025 in between 11.00
a.m. and 2.00 p.m. and shall cooperate in the  investigation.
 
[N.R.BORKAR, J.]
Dinesh S. Sherla 2/2
